Title: [Q] React with conviction vs. Stealth Ritus !

Messages.Author: djmi...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
This situation came up in our playgroup last time we played:

Player A announces Recruiting party and announces that he will do a
Stealth Ritus on the action, player B plays Determine in response.

What happens ?

A: Since the action is cancelled it is not possible to play action
modifiers on the action, hence the vampires performing the Stealth
Ritus don't burn/ don't pay a blood and the SR is returned to player
A's hand !

B: The action is cancelled but the vampires still burn/pay a blood
since the Stealth Ritus was played when the action was announced and is
not reversible !

I'm pretty sure that the answer is A, just need a confirmation !

Thx !

DJ Mik

Relevant Card-text:

Recruiting Party [Sabbat:R, SW:R]
Cardtype: Action
Clan: Ventrue antitribu
Each Ventrue antitribu in your uncontrolled region gains 1 blood from
the blood bank.

Determine [NoR:C]
Cardtype: Reaction
Cost: 1 Conviction
Virtue: Vision
Play when a monster controlled by your predator is bleeding you. Tap
this reacting imbued. The monster is now bleeding your predator's
predator.
Or play when a monster controlled by your predator or prey plays an
action card. Tap this reacting imbued and cancel that action card as it
is played (no cost is paid, and the monster doesn't tap). That monster
cannot play the same action card again this turn.

Stealth Ritus [BH:C/PTo2/PTr2]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 1 blood
Requires a ready Sabbat vampire. Only usable as the action is
announced.
Choose another ready Sabbat vampire you control. The chosen vampire
burns 1 blood, or this card has no effect. This action gets +1 stealth,
even if stealth is not yet needed.

>

The action needs to be canceled before any modifiers like Stealth Ritus
are played. If the acting methuselah played too quickly, back up and
let the other player play Determine (answer A). If the acting minion
gave adequate time (asking if people wanted to cancel his action, and
waiting for response), then it's too late to play Determine. This
rarely happens.

Witness1
-ItE

6.2 Resolving an action

Action modifiers and reaction cards can be played at any time during an
action (unless otherwise noted on card text), with the acting
Methuselah getting the opportunity to play first.

Acting minion declares action fully including cards that are played as
the action is announced. Action modifiers are paid for immediately.

Determine is allowed to be played next, cancelling the action. The card
was played and paid for, no backing up.

6.2 Summary of the course of an action (KMW rulebook)
"The action is declared, and the card used for the action is played, if
any. Tap the minion who is taking the action"

So, you may anounce a mind rape action and anounce that you are going
to use stealth ritus, BUT YOU HAVE TO PLAY THE ACTION CARD FIRST!!!!!
then the stealth ritus.... AS you play the action card (if any),
determine CAN interupt and cancel the action and thus you cannot play
stealth ritus... that simple... If one rushes ahead and plays both
cards at the same point, then rewind...
